senses.gloss: khāyati (Pali khāyita, ppp., only, Vin. 〔iii.213.8〕; = Skt. khādati, khādita; 〔§ 2.32〕), eats: aor. 3 sg. Mv 〔iii.299.11〕 na sānaṃ khāyi rākṣasī; otherwise only ppp. khāyita; Mv 〔ii.78.12〕 udakarākṣasena khāyito; in 14 khāyitaṃ is v.l. for ardhakhāditakaṃ; khāyitā(ḥ) 〔iii.72.13〕 (and 12 where Senart ākhāyitā with one ms., read either khāditā with v.l. or khāyitā; ā-khād- is Vedic only); 〔iii.84.17, 19〕; 〔166.7〕.
